_doc: #1765 Cloud Media Center > Games: a catalogue of well-known Android games by category, with the store icon, name, developer and short description of each. Served at runtime as shared/games-catalogue (same framework as store-phone-recommendations, #1749), never baked into an APK: the app fetches it from raw.githubusercontent.com with an ETag and keeps the last copy in its webview storage. `icon` is the store's own public listing image URL, loaded by the app at runtime and cached by the webview; no third-party artwork is committed or bundled. `source` is the listing store (play | fdroid); open-source games are all F-Droid. Install goes through Cloud Store when installed, otherwise the market:// (Play) or F-Droid listing intent; Open launches the installed game. Add a row to add a game; no Kotlin. #1776: `open_source` (bool) and `dimension` (2d | 3d) on every row drive Cloud Store's Search > Phone > Games split (Open source / Non open source, each by 2D and 3D). The optional `genre` names a section inside a split for the open-source rows (Strategy & Management, RPG & Roguelike, Rhythm & Puzzle/Board, Sandbox & Voxel, Racing, Platformer); a row without one is sectioned by its `category`. `source` may also be github (GitHub releases: `store_url` is the releases page, optional `apk` a direct asset URL Cloud Store installs from).
